description: A bespoke package composed by a god-tier user in the God Panel's package composer: a named bundle of references to already-built Workflow, PageConfig (routes/component-trees) and TenantTheme rows. Composing and publishing a package is what this entity supports; materializing/installing one into a target tenant is a separate, not-yet-built feature.

name.description: The one required free-text field in the composer UI

category.description: One of PackageManifest's fixed categories: social, entertainment, productivity, gaming, ecommerce, content, other

icon.description: Icon name from the app's existing icon set, picked via a filtered local picker, not typed

themeId.description: TenantTheme.id, if this package bundles a theme

version.description: Auto-managed by the composer, not manually typed
